papers.title: A Case for Stateless Mobile Core Network Functions in Space
papers.authors: Yuanjie Li; Hewu Li; Wei Liu; Lixin Liu; Yimei Chen; Jianping Wu; Qian Wu; Jun Liu; Zeqi Lai
evidence: §3 function splits; §4 design; §5 implementation; §6 and Table 4, PDF pp.10–13
papers.built_for_en: Satellite-hosted 5G core functions serve terrestrial mobile users.
papers.built_for_zh: 衛星承載 5G core functions，服務地面行動用戶。
papers.problem_en: High orbital mobility repeatedly migrates per-user core state and creates signaling overhead.
papers.problem_zh: 高速軌道移動反覆遷移用戶 core state，造成 signaling 負擔。
papers.design_en: Decouple function execution from state; anchor service areas geographically; store authenticated user state at the device and retrieve it locally.
papers.design_zh: 拆開 function execution 與 state，以固定地理服務區域承接 mobility，讓裝置保存可信 user state 並提供本地擷取。
papers.model_en: Function/state split taxonomy, geographic grid addressing, orbital dynamics, protocol state-machine analysis and cryptographic state tokens.
papers.model_zh: function/state 切分分類、地理網格位址、軌道動態、protocol state machine 與加密 state token。
papers.evaluation_en: Commodity Raspberry Pi 4 satellite prototype, UERANSIM device emulation and Open5GS home core; operational Tiantong/Inmarsat and terrestrial 5G signaling datasets; constellation-scale replay.
papers.evaluation_zh: Raspberry Pi 4 衛星 prototype、UERANSIM 裝置 emulation 與 Open5GS home core；Tiantong/Inmarsat 和地面 5G signaling datasets；星座規模 replay。
papers.baselines_en: 5G NTN, SkyCore, Baoyun, DPCM; protocol-function splits provide further empirical comparisons.
papers.baselines_zh: 5G NTN、SkyCore、Baoyun、DPCM；額外以 protocol-function split 比較功能成本。
papers.result_en: For Starlink-like replay, satellite signaling reductions are 122.2× versus 5G NTN, 17.5× versus SkyCore, 40.3× versus DPCM and 49.3× versus Baoyun (Table 4).
papers.result_zh: Starlink 型 replay 的 satellite signaling 降低幅度：對 5G NTN 為 122.2×、SkyCore 為 17.5×、DPCM 為 40.3×、Baoyun 為 49.3×（Table 4）。
papers.limitations_en: The deployed system evidence covers terrestrial protocol hardware and traces; constellation behavior follows orbital replay. Endpoint state requires device support and trustworthy token processing.
papers.limitations_zh: 實作證據涵蓋地面 protocol 硬體與 traces；星座行為由軌道 replay 建立。端點 state 需要裝置支援與可信 token 處理。

papers.title: SaTE: Low-Latency Traffic Engineering for Satellite Networks
papers.authors: Hao Wu; Yizhan Han; Mohit Rajpal; Qizhen Zhang; Jingxian Wang
evidence: §2 formulation; §3 GNN; §4 setup; §5.1–5.5; Appendix H.1 offline; PDF pp.9–12
papers.built_for_en: A controller allocates traffic across paths in a 4,236-satellite network.
papers.built_for_zh: controller 在 4,236 顆衛星網路的路徑間分配 traffic。
papers.problem_en: Solver latency makes allocations stale while links and traffic change.
papers.problem_zh: links 與 traffic 持續變動，solver 計算時間讓 allocation 過期。
papers.design_en: Use a heterogeneous graph of satellites, paths and traffic; three graph-attention modules predict allocations, with capacity trimming and topology/traffic/path pruning.
papers.design_zh: 以 satellite、path、traffic 建立 heterogeneous graph，三組 graph-attention module 預測 allocation，再進行 capacity trimming 與 topology/traffic/path pruning。
papers.model_en: Path-based multi-commodity throughput maximization; supervised GNN labels from Gurobi; Determinantal Point Process topology sampling.
papers.model_zh: path-based multi-commodity throughput maximization；Gurobi 提供 supervised GNN labels；Determinantal Point Process 抽樣 topology。
papers.evaluation_en: FCC-derived orbital simulations; 3M population-weighted users and 1,000 gateways; Poisson arrivals 125–500 flows/s; scaled 200Mbps ISLs and 50Mbps access; Azure A100; train/test 4:1 across 10,000 snapshots.
papers.evaluation_zh: FCC 軌道模擬；300 萬人口加權用戶與 1,000 gateways；Poisson arrivals 125–500 flows/s；縮放至 200Mbps ISL 與 50Mbps access；Azure A100；10,000 snapshots 以 4:1 分割 train/test。
papers.baselines_en: Gurobi, POP, ECMP with Water Filling, backpressure Satellite Routing, Teal, HARP.
papers.baselines_zh: Gurobi、POP、ECMP with Water Filling、backpressure Satellite Routing、Teal、HARP。
papers.result_en: 17ms mean allocation inference, 2,738× faster than Gurobi; online satisfied demand improves 23.5% with cross-shell lasers and 46.6% with ground relays. Incremental path calculation separately averages 56ms.
papers.result_zh: allocation inference 平均 17ms，較 Gurobi 快 2,738×；online satisfied demand 在 cross-shell laser 與 ground relay 情境提升 23.5% 和 46.6%。額外 incremental path calculation 平均 56ms。
papers.limitations_en: Gain depends on charging computation delay to every method; offline Gurobi remains the reference optimum. Scaled capacities express relative trends; aggregate throughput objective leaves individual-flow fairness as an extension.
papers.limitations_zh: 增益包含各方法 computation delay；offline Gurobi 提供最佳化參照。縮放容量呈現相對趨勢；aggregate throughput objective 的 individual-flow fairness 可進一步擴展。

papers.title: Small-scale LEO Satellite Networking for Global-scale Demands
papers.authors: Yuanjie Li; Yimei Chen; Jiabo Yang; Jinyao Zhang; Bowen Sun; Lixin Liu; Hewu Li; Jianping Wu; Zeqi Lai; Qian Wu; Jun Liu
evidence: §4.1 Equations 2–4; §4 MPC and anycast; §5 toolkit; §6.1–6.3, Fig.15; PDF pp.9–12
papers.built_for_en: A provider synthesizes a sparse constellation for specific geographic demand.
papers.built_for_zh: provider 依指定地理需求合成稀疏星座。
papers.problem_en: Uniform orbital supply serves spatially uneven demand with excess satellites and complex control updates.
papers.problem_zh: 均勻 orbital supply 對應空間分佈集中的 demand，造成衛星供給浪費與 control 更新成本。
papers.design_en: Combine diverse Earth-repeat orbits; approximate supply-demand matching; preserve geographic intents using orbital MPC; enforce geographic SRv6 segment anycast.
papers.design_zh: 組合多樣 Earth-repeat orbits，以近似演算法匹配 supply-demand，利用 orbital MPC 維持 geographic intent，再以 geographic SRv6 segment anycast 執行。
papers.model_en: Integer-program constellation synthesis, greedy matching approximation, model predictive control and geographic reachability verification.
papers.model_zh: integer-program 星座合成、greedy matching approximation、model predictive control 與 geographic reachability verification。
papers.evaluation_en: 64,800 candidate tracks, 4,050 cells, three real-demand scenarios; 6,793-satellite Jan2025 reference; packet-level 1,741-container StarryNet-derived hardware-in-loop. Each modeled satellite offers 3×200Gbps ISL and 96Gbps radio access.
papers.evaluation_zh: 64,800 candidate tracks、4,050 cells、三種 real-demand scenarios；2025 年 1 月 6,793 顆 reference；1,741-container 的 StarryNet 延伸 packet-level hardware-in-loop。模型每顆 satellite 配置 3×200Gbps ISL 與 96Gbps radio access。
papers.baselines_en: Starlink, MegaReduce, Gurobi v12.0 synthesis terminated at two months; geo-routing/IP control comparisons in §6.2–6.3.
papers.baselines_zh: Starlink、MegaReduce、Gurobi v12.0 合成執行兩個月後取 incumbent；§6.2–6.3 另比較 geo-routing/IP control。
papers.result_en: Strict demand matching gives 1,763/3,344/1,066 satellites versus 6,793 for customer/backbone/Latin-America demand; 99% availability gives 1,391/3,184/865. Planning takes 6.5–7.7h; control costs improve by 1–3 orders.
papers.result_zh: 嚴格 demand matching 在 customer/backbone/Latin-America 需求採 1,763/3,344/1,066 顆，相對 reference 6,793 顆；99% availability 採 1,391/3,184/865 顆。planning 為 6.5–7.7h；control cost 改善 1–3 個數量級。
papers.limitations_en: The 7.9× headline corresponds to regional demand at 99% availability. Capacity and orbital synthesis assumptions determine feasibility; global access traffic differs from all-to-all cluster traffic.
papers.limitations_zh: 7.9× headline 對應 regional demand 與 99% availability。capacity 與 orbital synthesis 假設共同決定 feasibility；全球 access traffic 與 cluster all-to-all traffic 具有各自需求。

papers.title: StarCDN: Moving Content Delivery Networks to Space
papers.authors: William X. Zheng; Aryan Taneja; Maleeha Masood; Anirudh Sabnis; Ramesh K. Sitaraman; Deepak Vasisht
evidence: §3 mechanism; §4 SpaceGEN; §5.1 setup; §5.2–5.4; Fig.5/7/10; PDF pp.7–10
papers.built_for_en: LEO Internet users access content cached on moving satellites.
papers.built_for_zh: LEO Internet 用戶存取移動衛星上的 cached content。
papers.problem_en: Orbital motion changes the user population served by each cache and reduces locality.
papers.problem_zh: orbital motion 改變各 cache 的服務用戶羣，降低 content locality。
papers.design_en: Assign consistent-hash buckets across nearby satellites; relay fetches from neighboring replicas so content flows against orbital motion; generate correlated requests using SpaceGEN.
papers.design_zh: 在鄰近衛星配置 consistent-hash buckets，從 neighboring replicas relay fetch，讓 content 逆 orbital motion 流動；以 SpaceGEN 建立 correlated requests。
papers.model_en: Consistent hashing and replica graph; trace-based cache replay with LRU; empirical locality and bucket/latency tradeoff.
papers.model_zh: consistent hashing 與 replica graph；LRU trace-based cache replay；量測 locality 與 bucket/latency tradeoff。
papers.evaluation_en: Akamai production object traces seed five-day synthetic traces; CosmicBeats 15s orbital time step; multiprocess TCP cache replayer; varied 10–100GB caches and L=4/9 buckets.
papers.evaluation_zh: Akamai production object traces 作為五天 synthetic traces 種子；CosmicBeats 15s orbital time step；multiprocess TCP cache replayer；10–100GB caches 與 L=4/9 buckets。
papers.baselines_en: Naive LRU, ideal static satellite cache; StarCDN hashing-only ablation; measured terrestrial CDN and regular Starlink idle latency.
papers.baselines_zh: Naive LRU、ideal static satellite cache、hashing-only ablation，以及 terrestrial CDN 和 regular Starlink idle latency 量測。
papers.result_en: Ground-to-space bandwidth falls to 20–25% of uncached access; modeled median latency 22ms versus observed idle Starlink 55ms. At 9.7% unavailable satellites, bandwidth savings remain 74%.
papers.result_zh: ground-to-space bandwidth 降至 uncached access 的 20–25%；模型 median latency 22ms，相對 idle Starlink 量測 55ms。9.7% satellite unavailable 的情境仍保留 74% bandwidth savings。
papers.limitations_en: Latency analysis estimates propagation; queue and satellite processing require additional measurements. More buckets increase ISL latency; failures reduce hit rate.
papers.limitations_zh: latency analysis 估計 propagation；queue 與 satellite processing 需要額外量測。更多 buckets 增加 ISL latency；failure 降低 hit rate。

papers.title: DeepSpace: Super Resolution Powered Efficient and Reliable Satellite Image Data Acquistion
papers.authors: Chuanhao Sun; Yu Zhang; Bill Tao; Deepak Vasisht; Mahesh K. Marina
papers.built_for_en: Earth-observation satellites transmit compact imagery for cloud reconstruction.
papers.built_for_zh: Earth-observation satellites 傳送精簡 imagery，由 cloud 重建。
papers.problem_en: Intermittent downlinks carry large images while satellite compute, storage and uplink budgets constrain compression.
papers.problem_zh: intermittent downlink 承載大量 images，同時 satellite compute、storage 與 uplink budget 限制 compression。
papers.design_en: Lightweight BLSH image hashing and adaptive sampling run onboard; cloud MoE wavelet-diffusion super resolution selects experts and checks reconstruction metadata.
papers.design_zh: onboard 執行輕量 BLSH image hashing 與 adaptive sampling；cloud MoE wavelet-diffusion super resolution 選 expert，並以 metadata 檢查 reconstruction。
papers.model_en: Image-distance geometry, compression-ratio optimization, SSIM-based fidelity constraints, diffusion models and post-hoc low-resolution/hash similarity checks.
papers.model_zh: image-distance geometry、compression-ratio optimization、SSIM fidelity constraints、diffusion models，以及 post-hoc low-resolution/hash similarity checks。
papers.evaluation_en: Five custom/public datasets: Planet-CAL/HK, FarmVibes, DEN-3/DEN-12; evaluate compression, mean/worst SSIM/PSNR, onboard processing/storage and downstream wildfire/cropland/plastic tasks.
papers.evaluation_zh: 五種 custom/public datasets：Planet-CAL/HK、FarmVibes、DEN-3/DEN-12；評估 compression、mean/worst SSIM/PSNR、onboard processing/storage 與 wildfire/cropland/plastic tasks。
papers.baselines_en: Lanczos interpolation; CS ADMM, gOMP, CoSaMP; DSCN/DCSN as printed, VQ-VAE-2; Kodan, Earth+; WaveDiff and SR3 in result tables.
papers.baselines_zh: Lanczos interpolation、CS ADMM/gOMP/CoSaMP、原文列 DSCN/DCSN、VQ-VAE-2、Kodan、Earth+、WaveDiff，與 result tables 中的 SR3。
papers.result_en: Reported mean CR is 146.4–320 depending on dataset. Planet-HK at CR256 yields SSIM0.91 and PSNR37.3dB versus WaveDiff0.80/33.5dB; uplink around 10Kbps.
papers.result_zh: 依 dataset，mean CR 為 146.4–320。Planet-HK 在 CR256 達 SSIM0.91、PSNR37.3dB；WaveDiff 為 0.80/33.5dB；uplink 約10Kbps。
papers.limitations_en: Cloud reconstruction performs most neural compute. Fidelity evidence measures images and downstream tasks; distributed LLM collectives require separate workloads.
papers.limitations_zh: cloud reconstruction 承擔主要 neural compute。fidelity 證據涵蓋 images 與 downstream tasks；distributed LLM collectives 需要各自 workloads。

papers.title: Dissecting the StarLink: Characterizing Queuing and Flow Dynamics in the Starlink Network
papers.authors: Hendrik Cech; Nitinder Mohan; Jörg Ott
evidence: §3 infrastructure; §4.1 queue; §4.2 capacity; §4.4 reset; §4.6 transport; PDF pp.2–12
papers.built_for_en: Transport designers characterize a commercial LEO access bottleneck packet by packet.
papers.built_for_zh: transport designers 逐 packet 刻畫 commercial LEO access bottleneck。
papers.problem_en: Macro throughput/RTT statistics obscure bandwidth allocation, queue policy and periodic resets.
papers.problem_zh: macro throughput/RTT statistics 隱藏 bandwidth allocation、queue policy 與 periodic resets。
papers.design_en: NetScalpel schedules synchronized UDP burst/rate/cooldown and TCP experiments around 15s cycles; reconstruct queues from paired timestamps and compare CCAs.
papers.design_zh: NetScalpel 在 15s cycle 安排 synchronized UDP burst/rate/cooldown 與 TCP 實驗，以 paired timestamps 重建 queues 並比較 CCAs。
papers.model_en: Event-based head-drop queue reconstruction, demand-dependent capacity ramp model, paired Wilcoxon tests and equivalence testing.
papers.model_zh: event-based head-drop queue reconstruction、demand-dependent capacity ramp model、paired Wilcoxon 與 equivalence testing。
papers.evaluation_en: Munich residential terminal plus US east/west validation; AWS Frankfurt near PoP; NTP-calibrated microsecond packet records and 5ms TCP_INFO; randomized experiments across reconfiguration intervals.
papers.evaluation_zh: Munich residential terminal 與 US east/west 驗證；AWS Frankfurt 鄰近 PoP；NTP 校準 microsecond packet records 與 5ms TCP_INFO；跨 reconfiguration intervals randomize experiments。
papers.baselines_en: Head-drop versus tail-drop models; RED/CoDel conceptual checks; BBRv1/v3, CUBIC, SatPipe and slow-start variants HyStart, HyStart++, SEARCH, SUSS.
papers.baselines_zh: head-drop/tail-drop models；RED/CoDel 機制比較；BBRv1/v3、CUBIC、SatPipe，及 HyStart、HyStart++、SEARCH、SUSS slow-start variants。
papers.result_en: Estimated queues ~1,500 DL/~4,000 UL packets; demand ramps 100/30Mbps baselines by 3.4×/2× in 400ms; bandwidth resets every 15s; flow delay isolation coexists with coupled DL loss.
papers.result_zh: estimated queues 約 DL1,500、UL4,000 packets；demand 使100/30Mbps baseline 在400ms增加3.4×/2×；bandwidth 每15s reset；flow delay isolation 與 coupled DL loss 並存。
papers.limitations_en: Observations describe Starlink implementation and measured terminals. Inter-satellite paths and internal operator state require further observability; demand-driven replay should preserve traffic dependence.
papers.limitations_zh: 觀察描述 Starlink implementation 與量測 terminals。inter-satellite path 和 operator state 需要更多 observability；demand-driven replay 應保留 traffic dependence。

papers.title: CommSAR: Enabling Bidirectional Communication in SAR Imaging Satellites via Shared Waveform
papers.authors: Yimin Zhao; Zhenning Li; Hao Pan; Hua Li; Minhao Cui; Jie Xiong; Yihai Wei; Yang Liu; Haonan Zhao; Mohan Zhang; Weibo Wang; Guihai Chen; Kaiyu Liu; Linghe Kong
evidence: §3 waveform; §4 prototype; §5.1 experimental split; §5.2–5.5; PDF pp.8–12
papers.built_for_en: SAR satellites exchange control data through the imaging waveform and reflected echoes.
papers.built_for_zh: SAR satellites 藉 imaging waveform 與 reflected echo 交換 control data。
papers.problem_en: Dedicated communication hardware, spectrum and power impose constellation-scale overhead.
papers.problem_zh: 專用 communication hardware、spectrum 與 power 增加 constellation-scale 成本。
papers.design_en: Encode downlink data by chirp-start frequency offsets; programmable ground metasurface uses differential phase modulation for uplink; opposite-slope pilots compensate mobility.
papers.design_zh: downlink 以 chirp-start frequency offset 編碼；ground programmable metasurface 以 differential phase modulation 建立 uplink；opposite-slope pilots 補償 mobility。
papers.model_en: Linear-frequency-modulated signal equations, matched filtering and radar cross section, Doppler estimation, differential BPSK, BER versus SNR.
papers.model_zh: linear-frequency-modulated signal equations、matched filtering/radar cross section、Doppler estimation、differential BPSK，以及 BER–SNR。
papers.evaluation_en: Actual commercial satellite supplies uplink IQ echoes and downlink channel traces; proposed downlink waveform is tested with FPGA channel replay in anechoic chamber; UAV interleaved imaging A/B isolates waveform effects.
papers.evaluation_zh: actual commercial satellite 提供 uplink IQ echo 與 downlink channel traces；proposed downlink waveform 由 FPGA channel replay 在 anechoic chamber 測試；UAV interleaved imaging A/B 隔離 waveform effects。
papers.baselines_en: Standard SAR LFM imaging, conventional Doppler compensation, SARLink uplink as related-rate reference; per-component ablations.
papers.baselines_zh: standard SAR LFM imaging、conventional Doppler compensation、SARLink uplink rate reference，以及 per-component ablations。
papers.result_en: Maximum modeled/tested waveform rates 105Kbps DL and 112Kbps UL; imaging evidence uses resolution, PSLR and ISLR. Final PDF112Kbps governs the author-page 120Kbps discrepancy.
papers.result_zh: waveform 最大設計/測試 rate：DL105Kbps、UL112Kbps；imaging 以 resolution、PSLR、ISLR 驗證。final PDF112Kbps 提供 author page120Kbps 的版本裁決依據。
papers.limitations_en: Each component has its own flight/testbed tier. Sparse TT&C-like rates serve control traffic; orbital AI fabric needs a separate high-bandwidth optical design.
papers.limitations_zh: 各 component 對應各自 flight/testbed tier。TT&C 型 rate 服務 control traffic；orbital AI fabric 需要另行高 bandwidth optical design。

papers.title: Planet-Scale IoT Connectivity via LEO Satellites
papers.authors: Ziyue Zhang; Xianjin Xia; Ruonan Li; Jinhong Liu; Yuanqing Zheng; Linghe Kong; Mo Li
evidence: §3 measurement; §4.2 design; §4.3 deployment; Appendix E capacity and G optimization; PDF pp.11–14
papers.built_for_en: Battery-powered ground IoT nodes send sparse sensor reports and bursty images through intermittent LEO contacts.
papers.built_for_zh: battery-powered ground IoT nodes 透過 intermittent LEO contact 傳送 sensor report 與 bursty images。
papers.problem_en: Retransmission overhead, unfavorable contact slots and prolonged radio monitoring inflate delay and energy.
papers.problem_zh: retransmission overhead、低品質 contact slot 與長時間 radio monitoring 增加 delay/energy。
papers.design_en: Coded NACK pipelines transmission and repeats compact missing-packet IDs; DtS-FC forecasts contact/link quality, defers costly slots and schedules sleep.
papers.design_zh: coded NACK pipeline transmission 並重複 compact missing-packet IDs；DtS-FC 預測 contact/link quality，移轉高成本 slot 並安排 sleep。
papers.model_en: Contact-window prediction; reliability deadline/repetition optimization for NACK; lookahead F-pass energy/latency flow-control optimization.
papers.model_zh: contact-window prediction；NACK reliability deadline/repetition optimization；F-pass lookahead energy/latency flow-control optimization。
papers.evaluation_en: Six-satellite X-SNO measurements; coded NACK tested on three nodes and production-equivalent ground satellite radios plus channel emulator; DtS-FC deployed on eight nodes for one month in Yunnan.
papers.evaluation_zh: six-satellite X-SNO measurements；coded NACK 在 three nodes、production-equivalent ground satellite radio 與 channel emulator 測試；DtS-FC 在 Yunnan eight nodes 部署一個月。
papers.baselines_en: Current operational SatIoT protocol; separate coded-NACK and DtS-FC evaluations.
papers.baselines_zh: current operational SatIoT protocol；coded-NACK 與 DtS-FC 分開評估。
papers.result_en: Ground-test coded NACK improves throughput 2.1× and reduces transmissions 75.1–83.3%; live DtS-FC cuts >20min packet fraction 23%→11% and energy/bit38%.
papers.result_zh: ground-test coded NACK 提升 throughput2.1×、減少 transmissions75.1–83.3%；live DtS-FC 將 >20min packet fraction 從23%降至11%，energy/bit降低38%。
papers.limitations_en: Production deployment validates ground-side DtS-FC; satellite-side NACK integration follows ground-test evidence. 200–300 concurrent-node capacity extrapolates from eight-node tests and simulation.
papers.limitations_zh: production deployment 驗證 ground-side DtS-FC；satellite-side NACK integration 以 ground-test 證據銜接。200–300 concurrent-node capacity 由 eight-node tests 與 simulation 外推。

papers.title: SDN in the Stratosphere: Loon’s Aerospace Mesh Network
papers.authors: Frank Uyeda; Marc Alvidrez; Erik Kline; Bryce Petrini; Brian Barritt; David Mandle; Aswin Chandy Alexander
evidence: §2 system; §3 predictive failure response; §4 control tiers; PDF pp.2–9
papers.built_for_en: Moving balloon base stations backhaul LTE service through steerable mesh links.
papers.built_for_zh: 移動 balloon base stations 透過 steerable mesh links 提供 LTE backhaul。
papers.problem_en: Motion and atmospheric conditions alter link feasibility while control-channel reliability varies.
papers.problem_zh: motion 與 atmospheric conditions 改變 link feasibility，control-channel reliability 也隨時間變動。
papers.design_en: Temporospatial SDN predicts radio feasibility and compiles topology/routing intents; local tracking, redundant links and hybrid satcom/in-band control support reactive recovery.
papers.design_zh: temporospatial SDN 預測 radio feasibility 並編譯 topology/routing intent；local tracking、redundant links 與 hybrid satcom/in-band control 支援 reactive recovery。
papers.model_en: Physical link-budget models, constrained topology/routing solver, predictive control and operational distributions of failure/recovery.
papers.model_zh: physical link-budget models、constrained topology/routing solver、predictive control 與 operational failure/recovery distributions。
papers.evaluation_en: Three years of production operation across three continents; meshes routinely 20+ balloons over 3000+km; comparison of planned withdrawals with unexpected failures.
papers.evaluation_zh: three years production operation、three continents；mesh 經常20+ balloons、跨度3000+km；比較 planned withdrawal 與 unexpected failure。
papers.baselines_en: Operational planned link withdrawals versus failed links; architecture and transceiver-count variants.
papers.baselines_zh: operational planned link withdrawals 與 failed links；architecture/transceiver-count variants。
papers.result_en: Among routes recovered within 5min, anticipated failures recover 37.8% faster on average;75% control-plane recoveries complete within 20s and 92.4% reuse existing links.
papers.result_zh: 在5min內恢復的 routes 中，anticipated failure 平均快37.8%；75% control-plane recovery 在20s內完成；92.4%使用既有 links。
papers.limitations_en: Stratospheric balloons form an adjacent NTN regime with wind-driven trajectories and atmosphere-dependent radio links. Orbital satellites require orbital/optical-specific parameterization.
papers.limitations_zh: stratospheric balloon 屬 adjacent NTN regime，trajectory 受 wind 驅動、radio link 受 atmosphere 影響。orbital satellite 需 orbital/optical 專用參數。

papers.title: Known Knowns and Unknowns: Near-realtime Earth Observation Via Query Bifurcation in Serval
papers.authors: Bill Tao; Om Chabra; Ishani Janveja; Indranil Gupta; Deepak Vasisht
evidence: §3 query bifurcation; §4 implementation; §5 evaluation, Table 1–2 and Fig.6–11; PDF pp.7–11
papers.built_for_en: Nearly 200 Planet Dove imaging satellites answer prioritized Earth-observation queries.
papers.built_for_zh: 接近 200 顆 Planet Dove 成像衛星迴答具優先級的 Earth-observation queries。
papers.problem_en: Downlink queues place urgent imagery behind large background collections; onboard compute and energy budgets constrain image filtering.
papers.problem_zh: downlink queue 將急迫影像排在大量背景資料之後；onboard compute 與 energy budget 限制 image filtering。
papers.design_en: Bifurcate queries into slowly changing ground-precomputed predicates and dynamic onboard predicates; schedule compute and downlink by query priority.
papers.design_zh: 將 query 拆成由地面預先計算的緩慢變動 predicates，以及衛星執行的動態 predicates；依 query priority 安排 compute 與 downlink。
papers.model_en: Boolean query composition, spatial intersections, contact schedules, compute queues and solar/battery energy accounting.
papers.model_zh: Boolean query composition、空間交集、contact schedules、compute queues 與 solar/battery 能量帳。
papers.evaluation_en: Planet metadata for ten million images over July 1–20, 2021; Jetson AGX Orin profiling at 15 W and 30 W; orbit/contact simulation with traditional and distributed ground stations, keeping aggregate downlink constant.
papers.evaluation_zh: 使用 2021 年 7 月 1–20 日一千萬張 Planet 影像 metadata；在 15 W 與 30 W 下量測 Jetson AGX Orin；以軌道/contact simulation 比較傳統與分散 ground stations，維持 aggregate downlink。
papers.baselines_en: In-order delivery, in-order delivery with distributed ground stations; component ablations of compute, weather prediction and historical forest labels; OEC-inspired filtering comparison.
papers.baselines_zh: in-order delivery、搭配 distributed ground stations 的 in-order delivery；compute、weather prediction、historical forest labels 的 component ablations；OEC-inspired filtering comparison。
papers.result_en: At 15 W, traditional-station median latency drops from 78.2 h to 1.1 h; distributed-station median drops from 71.71 h to 0.03 h. The 47-minute P90 headline uses the distributed-station condition.
papers.result_zh: 15 W 時，傳統 ground-station median latency 從 78.2 h 降至 1.1 h；分散 ground-station median 從 71.71 h 降至 0.03 h。P90 47 分鐘的 headline 對應分散 ground-station 條件。
papers.limitations_en: Results describe prioritized imagery and metadata predicates; cluster-scale LLM collectives require accelerator and fabric measurements. Distributed ground stations contribute separately to latency gains.
papers.limitations_zh: 結果涵蓋 priority imagery 與 metadata predicates；cluster-scale LLM collectives 需要 accelerator 與 fabric measurements。distributed ground stations 對 latency gains 提供獨立貢獻。

papers.title: StarryNet: Empowering Researchers to Evaluate Futuristic Integrated Space and Terrestrial Networks
papers.authors: Zeqi Lai; Hewu Li; Yangtao Deng; Qian Wu; Jun Liu; Yuanjie Li; Jihao Li; Lixin Liu; Weisen Liu; Jianping Wu
evidence: §3–5 architecture; §6 fidelity, scalability and applications, PDF pp.8–13
papers.built_for_en: Containerized satellite and terrestrial network software runs against time-evolving constellation links.
papers.built_for_zh: containerized 衛星與地面 network software 在隨時間演變的星座 links 上執行。
papers.problem_en: Thousands of mobile nodes require synchronized geometry, network-state updates and realistic software execution on terrestrial hosts.
papers.problem_zh: 數千個 mobile nodes 需要同步 geometry、network-state updates 與地面 host 上的實際 software execution。
papers.design_en: Combine public orbital information, physical-to-virtual mapping, Linux containers, traffic-control link updates and multi-host manager/worker orchestration.
papers.design_zh: 結合公開軌道資料、physical-to-virtual mapping、Linux containers、traffic-control link updates 與 multi-host manager/worker orchestration。
papers.model_en: Orbit propagation, geometric link feasibility, time-dependent graph mapping, resource capping and distributed event synchronization.
papers.model_zh: 軌道推算、幾何 link feasibility、time-dependent graph mapping、resource capping 與 distributed event synchronization。
papers.evaluation_en: Eight Dell PowerEdge R740 servers; Starlink, Kuiper and Telesat configurations; ping/iperf validation against live European Starlink traces and CoreMark checks for virtual compute capacity.
papers.evaluation_zh: 八臺 Dell PowerEdge R740；Starlink、Kuiper、Telesat configurations；以歐洲 live Starlink traces 的 ping/iperf 驗證，並用 CoreMark 檢查 virtual compute capacity。
papers.baselines_en: Hypatia, StarPerf, live Starlink measurements and physical-device CoreMark reference.
papers.baselines_zh: Hypatia、StarPerf、live Starlink measurements 與 physical-device CoreMark reference。
papers.result_en: A 4,408-satellite configuration initializes in 21.2 minutes using seven workers; 1-second updates consume 39.6% host CPU in the reported setup.
papers.result_zh: 4,408-satellite configuration 使用七個 workers 在 21.2 分鐘完成初始化；報告 setup 的 1-second updates 消耗 39.6% host CPU。
papers.limitations_en: Fidelity follows the configured orbit, topology, link model and available traces. Commercial scheduler inference and future optical-terminal behavior call for explicit calibration.
papers.limitations_zh: fidelity 隨 configured orbit、topology、link model 與 available traces 決定。commercial scheduler inference 與 future optical-terminal behavior 需要明確 calibration。

papers.title: Exploring the “Internet from space” with Hypatia
papers.authors: Simon Kassing; Debopam Bhattacherjee; André Baptista Águas; Jens Eirik Saethre; Ankit Singla
evidence: §3 framework; §4 architecture, fidelity and runtime; §5 TCP/UDP investigations, PDF pp.4–13
papers.built_for_en: Proposed Starlink, Kuiper and Telesat constellations carry packet-level Internet traffic.
papers.built_for_zh: 規劃中的 Starlink、Kuiper 與 Telesat 星座承載 packet-level Internet traffic。
papers.problem_en: Orbital motion changes path delay, routing and link load while TCP reacts to the evolving packet sequence and queues.
papers.problem_zh: orbital motion 改變 path delay、routing 與 link load，同時 TCP 對變動中的 packet sequence 與 queues 作出反應。
papers.design_en: Precompute orbital and forwarding snapshots, feed them into ns-3 packet simulation, and visualize trajectories through Cesium.
papers.design_zh: 預先計算 orbital 與 forwarding snapshots，送入 ns-3 packet simulation，並以 Cesium 視覺化 trajectories。
papers.model_en: Time-varying +Grid graph, shortest paths, continuous geometric propagation delay, discrete-event queues and transport state.
papers.model_zh: time-varying +Grid graph、shortest paths、continuous geometric propagation delay、discrete-event queues 與 transport state。
papers.evaluation_en: FCC/ITU planned constellation parameters; validation against NetworkX Floyd–Warshall paths and ns-3 ping; TCP CUBIC and UDP workloads; runtime scaling across traffic rates.
papers.evaluation_zh: FCC/ITU 規劃星座參數；以 NetworkX Floyd–Warshall paths 與 ns-3 ping 驗證；TCP CUBIC、UDP workloads；比較 traffic rate 對 runtime scaling 的影響。
papers.baselines_en: Analytical shortest-path distance, ns-3 ping consistency checks, alternative ground-station and routing configurations, TCP/UDP flow scenarios.
papers.baselines_zh: analytical shortest-path distance、ns-3 ping consistency checks、替代 ground-station/routing configurations、TCP/UDP flow scenarios。
papers.result_en: On one 2.26 GHz Xeon L5520 core, a 10 Gbps flow over 10 simulated seconds takes approximately 33 minutes for UDP and 100 minutes for TCP. Packet experiments expose motion-induced RTT changes and reordering.
papers.result_zh: 在單顆 2.26 GHz Xeon L5520 core 上，10 Gbps flow 的 10 simulated seconds 約需 UDP 33 分鐘、TCP 100 分鐘。packet experiments 揭示 motion-induced RTT changes 與 reordering。
papers.limitations_en: The model represents specified planned topology and forwarding policies. Runtime cost grows with packet count; RF scheduling, live commercial TE and terminal dynamics require dedicated models.
papers.limitations_zh: 模型代表指定的 planned topology 與 forwarding policies。runtime cost 隨 packet count 增長；RF scheduling、live commercial TE 與 terminal dynamics 需要專用 models。

papers.title: Network topology design at 27,000 km/hour
papers.authors: Debopam Bhattacherjee; Ankit Singla
evidence: §3 ILP; §4 motifs; §5 latitude-dependent motifs; §6–7 evaluation, Table 1 and Fig.7–11
papers.built_for_en: Dense LEO constellations provide low-latency high-capacity inter-satellite paths.
papers.built_for_zh: 密集 LEO constellations 提供低延遲、高容量的 inter-satellite paths。
papers.problem_en: Bounded optical-terminal degree, link range and moving geometry create a combinatorial topology-design problem.
papers.problem_zh: 有限 optical-terminal degree、link range 與 moving geometry 形成 combinatorial topology-design problem。
papers.design_en: Enumerate repeating local connectivity motifs, then customize motifs across latitude zones to preserve useful links through orbital motion.
papers.design_zh: 列舉 repeating local connectivity motifs，再依 latitude zones 調整 motifs，讓 orbital motion 期間維持有用 links。
papers.model_en: Mixed integer linear programming; degree and visibility constraints; weighted objective Mα=α·stretch+hop count; symmetry reduction and exhaustive motif search.
papers.model_zh: mixed integer linear programming、degree/visibility constraints；weighted objective Mα=α·stretch+hop count；symmetry reduction 與 exhaustive motif search。
papers.evaluation_en: Population-weighted traffic among 1,000 cities, plus GDP-weighted traffic among 100 cities; inclined 40×40 constellation and planned Starlink/Kuiper; sweeps of laser range and acquisition time.
papers.evaluation_zh: 1,000 城市的 population-weighted traffic，加上 100 城市的 GDP-weighted traffic；inclined 40×40 constellation 與 planned Starlink/Kuiper；掃描 laser range 與 acquisition time。
papers.baselines_en: +Grid neighbor connectivity; ILP on small city sets; uniform motif and latitude-dependent multi-motif variants.
papers.baselines_zh: +Grid neighbor connectivity；small city sets 的 ILP；uniform motif 與 latitude-dependent multi-motif variants。
papers.result_en: Multi-motif designs improve the weighted hop/stretch objective by up to 54% for Starlink and 45% for Kuiper relative to +Grid. These percentages describe the paper’s network-efficiency objective.
papers.result_zh: 相較 +Grid，multi-motif designs 對 weighted hop/stretch objective 的改進最高達 Starlink 54%、Kuiper 45%。這些比例對應論文的 network-efficiency objective。
papers.limitations_en: Hop count serves as a capacity proxy; throughput and collective completion require explicit capacities, queues and workload placement. Motif symmetry assumes regular constellation structure.
papers.limitations_zh: hop count 作為 capacity proxy；throughput 與 collective completion 需要明確 capacities、queues 與 workload placement。motif symmetry 假設規則星座結構。

papers.title: StarPerf: Characterizing Network Performance for Emerging Mega-Constellations
papers.authors: Zeqi Lai; Hewu Li; Jihao Li
evidence: §III simulator; §IV constellation comparison; §V satellite/cloud relay; Fig.2–3, Fig.10–11
papers.built_for_en: Area-to-area satellite connectivity and hybrid cloud/satellite interactive communication.
papers.built_for_zh: area-to-area 衛星 connectivity，以及 hybrid cloud/satellite interactive communication。
papers.problem_en: Constellation scale, architectural options and path choice jointly determine attainable performance.
papers.problem_zh: constellation scale、architectural options 與 path choice 共同決定 attainable performance。
papers.design_en: Build orbital area-to-area performance models and constellation scaling; choose low-latency satellite or cloud relays using measured historical path information.
papers.design_zh: 建立 orbital area-to-area performance models 與 constellation scaling；以 measured historical path information 選擇 low-latency satellite/cloud relay。
papers.model_en: Geometric constellation graph, hexagonal Earth regions, path latency/capacity profiling and average-latency relay selection.
papers.model_zh: geometric constellation graph、hexagonal Earth regions、path latency/capacity profiling 與 average-latency relay selection。
papers.evaluation_en: Constellation simulation plus laptops running WebRTC; traffic-control reproduces model-predicted satellite delay while cloud routes use measured terrestrial delays.
papers.evaluation_zh: constellation simulation 搭配執行 WebRTC 的 laptops；traffic-control 重現模型預測的 satellite delay，cloud routes 使用 measured terrestrial delays。
papers.baselines_en: Terrestrial cloud relay, satellite relay and hybrid relay-selection configurations; constellation architecture variants.
papers.baselines_zh: terrestrial cloud relay、satellite relay、hybrid relay-selection configurations；constellation architecture variants。
papers.result_en: The hybrid relay prototype reduces end-to-end interactive latency by up to 62% under the evaluated long-distance communication cases.
papers.result_zh: hybrid relay prototype 在評估的 long-distance communication cases 下，end-to-end interactive latency 最高降低 62%。
papers.limitations_en: Prototype satellite paths inherit simulated delay. Packet-level congestion and optical acquisition require additional calibration.
papers.limitations_zh: prototype satellite paths 沿用 simulated delay。packet-level congestion 與 optical acquisition 需要額外 calibration。

papers.title: Deciphering the Enigma of Satellite Computing with COTS Devices: Measurement and Analysis
papers.authors: Ruolin Xing; Mengwei Xu; Ao Zhou; Qing Li; Yiran Zhang; Feng Qian; Shangguang Wang
evidence: §2 setup and Table 1; §3 thermal; §4 energy; §5 performance, PDF pp.3–13
papers.built_for_en: BUPT-1 carries commodity edge computers in approximately 490 km sun-synchronous orbit.
papers.built_for_zh: BUPT-1 在約 490 km sun-synchronous orbit 承載 commodity edge computers。
papers.problem_en: Thermal coupling, sunlight-dependent energy and device execution interact under satellite operating conditions.
papers.problem_zh: thermal coupling、sunlight-dependent energy 與 device execution 在 satellite operating conditions 下互相影響。
papers.design_en: Instrument live devices and a matched terrestrial counterpart; compare controlled CPU/accelerator loads, temperature, battery and performance traces.
papers.design_zh: 量測 live devices 與匹配的 terrestrial counterpart；比較 controlled CPU/accelerator loads、temperature、battery 與 performance traces。
papers.model_en: Energy accounting, orbit-aligned sunlight profiles, thermal-response analysis and matched workload microbenchmarks.
papers.model_zh: energy accounting、orbit-aligned sunlight profiles、thermal-response analysis 與 matched workload microbenchmarks。
papers.evaluation_en: Six months, over 1,000 experiment hours and 10 million telemetry lines; a 17.44 kg spacecraft with two Huawei Atlas 200 DK boards, two Raspberry Pi boards and two 115 Wh batteries.
papers.evaluation_zh: 六個月、超過 1,000 experiment hours 與一千萬 telemetry lines；17.44 kg spacecraft 配置兩臺 Huawei Atlas 200 DK、兩臺 Raspberry Pi 與兩顆 115 Wh batteries。
papers.baselines_en: Ground counterpart with matching compute devices, thermal construction and workloads; load/thread/frequency and battery-depth sweeps.
papers.baselines_zh: ground counterpart 使用匹配的 compute devices、thermal construction 與 workloads；掃描 load/thread/frequency 與 battery depth。
papers.result_en: Thermal throttling yields up to 10% performance reduction in the measured devices; sustained 9 W operation over 10 hours creates temperatures above 30°C and instability in the reported configuration.
papers.result_zh: 量測裝置的 thermal throttling 造成最高 10% performance reduction；報告 configuration 中持續 9 W 執行 10 小時，使 temperature 超過 30°C 並產生 instability。
papers.limitations_en: The six-month experiment grounds edge-device energy and thermal models. GPU-rich orbital clusters require device-specific radiation, radiator and sustained-power evidence.
papers.limitations_zh: 六個月實驗為 edge-device energy 與 thermal models 提供實證。GPU-rich orbital clusters 需要 device-specific radiation、radiator 與 sustained-power evidence。

papers.title: Democratizing Direct-to-Cell Low Earth Orbit Satellite Networks
papers.authors: Lixin Liu; Yuanjie Li; Hewu Li; Jiabo Yang; Wei Liu; Jingyi Lan; Yufeng Wang; Jiarui Li; Jianping Wu; Qian Wu; Jun Liu; Zeqi Lai
evidence: §2–3 function splits; §5 protocol; §6 prototype; §7 evaluation and Table 1, PDF pp.10–13
papers.built_for_en: Multiple mobile operators lease LEO satellites to serve regular phones and IoT devices.
papers.built_for_zh: 多個 mobile operators 租用 LEO satellites，服務 regular phones 與 IoT devices。
papers.problem_en: Hop-by-hop cellular sessions couple satellite operators, mobile operators and devices as orbital movement repeatedly changes their relationship.
papers.problem_zh: hop-by-hop cellular sessions 將 satellite operators、mobile operators 與 devices 耦合，orbital movement 反覆改變三者關係。
papers.design_en: Signed pay-as-you-go service tokens let satellites locally authorize service; geographic cells and end-to-end mobile sessions stabilize service policy.
papers.design_zh: signed pay-as-you-go service tokens 讓 satellites 在本地授權服務；geographic cells 與 end-to-end mobile sessions 穩定 service policy。
papers.model_en: Protocol state machines, cryptographic trust tokens, function-split deadlines, geographic service mappings and orbital trace replay.
papers.model_zh: protocol state machines、cryptographic trust tokens、function-split deadlines、geographic service mappings 與 orbital trace replay。
papers.evaluation_en: Commodity cellular/SIM prototype and constellation-driven signaling simulations; evaluate multi-operator access, paging load and service resumption.
papers.evaluation_zh: commodity cellular/SIM prototype 與 constellation-driven signaling simulations；評估 multi-operator access、paging load 與 service resumption。
papers.baselines_en: 3GPP transparent satellite pipe, onboard distributed-unit and onboard full-RAN function splits; SpaceCore comparison; module ablations.
papers.baselines_zh: 3GPP transparent satellite pipe、onboard distributed-unit、onboard full-RAN function splits；SpaceCore comparison；module ablations。
papers.result_en: Reported service-resumption latency improves 4.71–14.25× and signaling costs improve 850–7,640× in the evaluated multi-tenant mobility conditions.
papers.result_zh: 在評估的 multi-tenant mobility 條件下，service-resumption latency 改善 4.71–14.25×，signaling costs 改善 850–7,640×。
papers.limitations_en: Results concern access authorization and mobile-session control. Orbital datacenter collectives need separate high-bandwidth transport and accelerator experiments.
papers.limitations_zh: 結果涵蓋 access authorization 與 mobile-session control。orbital datacenter collectives 需要獨立的 high-bandwidth transport 與 accelerator experiments。

papers.title: Making Sense of Constellations: Methodologies for Understanding Starlink’s Scheduling Algorithms
papers.authors: Hammas Bin Tanveer; Mike Puchol; Rachee Singh; Antonio Bianchi; Rishab Nithyanand
evidence: §3–4 obstruction-map methodology; §5–6 model; §7–8 scope, PDF pp.3–8
papers.built_for_en: Consumer Starlink terminals expose signals for inferring serving-satellite assignment.
papers.built_for_zh: consumer Starlink terminals 提供可推估 serving-satellite assignment 的 signals。
papers.problem_en: Public terminal observations must separate physical satellite visibility from the operator’s assignment decisions.
papers.problem_zh: 公開 terminal observations 需要分辨 physical satellite visibility 與 operator assignment decisions。
papers.design_en: Difference consecutive obstruction maps across 15-second slots; align sky tracks with public orbital predictions; train a satellite-characteristic predictor.
papers.design_zh: 對連續 15-second slots 的 obstruction maps 作差分；將 sky tracks 與公開 orbital predictions 對齊；訓練 satellite-characteristic predictor。
papers.model_en: Map differencing, dynamic time warping, orbital geometry, random-forest classification and feature-importance analysis.
papers.model_zh: map differencing、dynamic time warping、orbital geometry、random-forest classification 與 feature-importance analysis。
papers.evaluation_en: Real-terminal measurements at geographically distributed sites; 80% training split with five-fold cross validation, 20% holdout and top-k accuracy.
papers.evaluation_zh: 在 geographically distributed sites 量測 real terminals；80% training split 搭配 five-fold cross validation、20% holdout 與 top-k accuracy。
papers.baselines_en: A predictor that ranks clusters by the number of visible available satellites.
papers.baselines_zh: 依 visible available satellites 數量對 clusters 排序的 predictor。
papers.result_en: Top-5 allocated-satellite characteristic accuracy reaches 65%, versus 22% for the availability-count baseline.
papers.result_zh: top-5 allocated-satellite characteristic accuracy 達 65%，availability-count baseline 為 22%。
papers.limitations_en: The model predicts characteristic clusters in measured northern-latitude sites. Satellite identities, other latitude ranges and firmware revisions require fresh validation. Venue status is CoNEXT Companion.
papers.limitations_zh: 模型預測量測 northern-latitude sites 的 characteristic clusters。satellite identities、其他 latitude ranges 與 firmware revisions 需要新 validation。venue 為 CoNEXT Companion。

papers.title: Dissecting the Performance of Satellite Network Operators
papers.authors: Aravindh Raman; Matteo Varvello; Hyunseok Chang; Nishanth Sastry; Yasir Zaki
evidence: §3 operator identification and data; §4 network performance; §5 application experiments; appendix participant counts
papers.built_for_en: LEO, MEO and GEO satellite operators serve public Internet subscribers.
papers.built_for_zh: LEO、MEO 與 GEO satellite operators 服務 public Internet subscribers。
papers.problem_en: Operator-level measurements need robust access identification, broad vantage coverage and application-level evidence.
papers.problem_zh: operator-level measurements 需要穩健的 access identification、廣泛 vantage coverage 與 application-level evidence。
papers.design_en: Combine ASN/operator classification with latency-distribution filtering, M-Lab and RIPE Atlas data, then collect browser/video experiments from recruited subscribers.
papers.design_zh: 結合 ASN/operator classification、latency-distribution filtering、M-Lab 與 RIPE Atlas data，再向 recruited subscribers 收集 browser/video experiments。
papers.model_en: Kernel density estimation, longitudinal empirical distributions, operator/access classification and measurement-sample validation.
papers.model_zh: kernel density estimation、longitudinal empirical distributions、operator/access classification 與 measurement-sample validation。
papers.evaluation_en: Public longitudinal datasets across 18 satellite operators plus Prolific participant recruitment. The survey identifies 57 satellite subscribers among 14,371 screened participants; application experiments use their validated subset.
papers.evaluation_zh: 跨 18 家 satellite operators 的公開 longitudinal datasets，搭配 Prolific participant recruitment。survey 在 14,371 位 screened participants 中辨識 57 位 satellite subscribers；application experiments 使用 validated subset。
papers.baselines_en: Cross-operator LEO/MEO/GEO comparisons, terrestrial references and access-specific webpage/video comparisons.
papers.baselines_zh: cross-operator LEO/MEO/GEO comparisons、terrestrial references 與 access-specific webpage/video comparisons。
papers.result_en: Measured Starlink access adds approximately 30–40 ms relative to favorable terrestrial connectivity; remote PoP choice produces roughly doubled latency in the Philippines example.
papers.result_zh: 量測 Starlink access 相對條件佳的 terrestrial connectivity 增加約 30–40 ms；Philippines example 的 remote PoP choice 造成約兩倍 latency。
papers.limitations_en: Public speed tests and recruited users define the sample. ASN filtering, single-flow TCP behavior and geolocation quality shape interpretation.
papers.limitations_zh: public speed tests 與 recruited users 定義 sample。ASN filtering、single-flow TCP behavior 與 geolocation quality 影響 interpretation。

papers.title: A First Look at Starlink Performance
papers.authors: François Michel; Martino Trevisan; Danilo Giordano; Olivier Bonaventure
evidence: §2 measurement setup, Table 1; §3 network; §4 web; §5 QUIC and emulator, PDF pp.3–8
papers.built_for_en: A regular Starlink subscription in Louvain-la-Neuve, Belgium carries Internet and web traffic.
papers.built_for_zh: Belgium Louvain-la-Neuve 的 regular Starlink subscription 承載 Internet 與 web traffic。
papers.problem_en: Interactive latency, packet loss, throughput and application behavior change under loaded satellite access.
papers.problem_zh: interactive latency、packet loss、throughput 與 application behavior 隨 loaded satellite access 改變。
papers.design_en: Run periodic RIPE-anchor pings and Ookla tests, controlled QUIC transfers and BrowserTime experiments; publish a trace-based ERRANT emulation model.
papers.design_zh: 執行 periodic RIPE-anchor pings、Ookla tests、controlled QUIC transfers 與 BrowserTime experiments；公開 trace-based ERRANT emulation model。
papers.model_en: Empirical latency/throughput distributions, packet-loss reconstruction, load-dependent RTT and trace-driven access emulation.
papers.model_zh: empirical latency/throughput distributions、packet-loss reconstruction、load-dependent RTT 與 trace-driven access emulation。
papers.evaluation_en: Five months of latency probes to 11 RIPE anchors, four months of speed tests and top-120 Belgian websites; 100 MB HTTP/3 transfers and light real-time QUIC message streams.
papers.evaluation_zh: 五個月對 11 個 RIPE anchors 的 latency probes；四個月 speed tests 與 Belgian top-120 websites；100 MB HTTP/3 transfers 與 light real-time QUIC message streams。
papers.baselines_en: Commercial GEO service, UCLouvain wired 1 Gbps reference, HTTP/2 TCP and HTTP/3 QUIC behavior.
papers.baselines_zh: commercial GEO service、UCLouvain wired 1 Gbps reference、HTTP/2 TCP 與 HTTP/3 QUIC behavior。
papers.result_en: The nearby-anchor minimum RTTs shown in the paper fall near 20–29 ms. Loaded-transfer experiments reveal queue-related latency and losses beyond those minimum values.
papers.result_zh: 論文中 nearby-anchor minimum RTTs 約為 20–29 ms。loaded-transfer experiments 揭示額外 queue-related latency 與 losses。
papers.limitations_en: One Belgian terminal and the early-2022 deployment define this measurement regime. Subsequent constellation and terminal revisions benefit from fresh calibration.
papers.limitations_zh: 單一 Belgian terminal 與 early-2022 deployment 定義量測 regime。後續 constellation 與 terminal revisions 需要新 calibration。

papers.title: Assessing LEO Satellite Networks for National Emergency Failover
papers.authors: Vaibhav Bhosale; Ying Zhang; Sameer Kapoor; Robin Kim; Miguel Schlicht; Muskaan Gupta; Ekaterina Tumanova; Zachary S. Bischof; Fabián E. Bustamante; Alberto Dainotti; Ahmed Saeed
evidence: §3 capacity graph and allocation; §4 data; §5 six case studies, Table 1–2; PDF pp.4–11
papers.built_for_en: National satellite access supplements international connectivity after submarine-cable failures.
papers.built_for_zh: national satellite access 在 submarine-cable failures 後補充 international connectivity。
papers.problem_en: Population placement, RF beams, spectrum reuse, gateways and policy jointly cap country-scale backup capacity.
papers.problem_zh: population placement、RF beams、spectrum reuse、gateways 與 policy 共同限制 country-scale backup capacity。
papers.design_en: Build a capacity graph with beam and interference constraints; allocate terminals and RF resources, then solve global or policy-restricted capacity flows.
papers.design_zh: 建立含 beam 與 interference constraints 的 capacity graph；配置 terminals、RF resources，再解 global 或 policy-restricted capacity flows。
papers.model_en: NetworkX max-flow/min-cost capacity bounds; geometric beam feasibility; greedy capacity balancing and terminal-placement heuristics.
papers.model_zh: NetworkX max-flow/min-cost capacity bounds；geometric beam feasibility；greedy capacity balancing 與 terminal-placement heuristics。
papers.evaluation_en: Six real cable-failure case studies using RIPE Atlas and Calypso route/cable mappings; modeled Starlink regulatory configurations and terminal-count sweeps up to 50,000.
papers.evaluation_zh: 六個真實 cable-failure case studies 使用 RIPE Atlas 與 Calypso route/cable mappings；採 modeled Starlink regulatory configurations，掃描最高 50,000 terminals。
papers.baselines_en: Population-proportional terminal placement, greedy capacity balancing, global versus domestic-restricted TE and alternative RF configurations.
papers.baselines_zh: population-proportional terminal placement、greedy capacity balancing、global/domestic-restricted TE 與 alternative RF configurations。
papers.result_en: Table 1 bounds range from 41 Gbps for Tonga to 4,653 Gbps for South Africa; comparison to lost cable capacity ranges from 0.9% for Great Britain to 434% for Haiti.
papers.result_zh: Table 1 的 bounds 從 Tonga 41 Gbps 到 South Africa 4,653 Gbps；與 lost cable capacity 比較從 Great Britain 0.9% 到 Haiti 434%。
papers.limitations_en: Capacity values are optimistic graph bounds conditioned on terminal placement and RF configuration. The represented interference model covers intra-satellite reuse; weather, terrain and inter-satellite interference motivate refinement.
papers.limitations_zh: capacity values 為以 terminal placement 與 RF configuration 為條件的 optimistic graph bounds。interference model 涵蓋 intra-satellite reuse；weather、terrain 與 inter-satellite interference 提供 refinement 方向。

papers.title: LeoCC: Making Internet Congestion Control Robust to LEO Satellite Dynamics
papers.authors: Zeqi Lai; Zonglun Li; Qian Wu; Hewu Li; Jihao Li; Xin Xie; Yuanjie Li; Jun Liu; Jianping Wu
evidence: §4.1 reconfiguration detector; §4.2 Kalman/max estimators; §5 LeoReplayer; §6.1–6.7 evaluation, Figure10–21; browser source PDF pp.4–13
papers.evidence_status: Complete public article-reader primary text reviewed
papers.built_for_en: End-to-end TCP traffic traverses commercial LEO satellite access and terrestrial Internet paths.
papers.built_for_zh: end-to-end TCP traffic 經過 commercial LEO satellite access 與 terrestrial Internet paths。
papers.problem_en: Connection reconfiguration abruptly changes capacity and base RTT; intrinsic delay jitter and radio loss distort conventional congestion estimates.
papers.problem_zh: connection reconfiguration 突然改變 capacity 與 base RTT；固有 delay jitter 與 radio loss 影響 conventional congestion estimates。
papers.design_en: Detect ACK-response-interval outliers and PoP ICMP signals; reset obsolete samples at reconfiguration, combine Kalman/max bandwidth estimates and RTT-band estimates, and transition between dynamic cruise and reconfiguration adaptation.
papers.design_zh: 偵測 ACK-response-interval outliers 與 PoP ICMP signals；在 reconfiguration 更新過期 samples，結合 Kalman/max bandwidth estimates 與 RTT-band estimates，並在 dynamic cruise、reconfiguration adaptation 間轉換。
papers.model_en: Piecewise reconfiguration intervals, state-machine rate control, Kalman filtering, moving max/min filters and delay-based bottleneck discrimination.
papers.model_zh: piecewise reconfiguration intervals、state-machine rate control、Kalman filtering、moving max/min filters 與 delay-based bottleneck discrimination。
papers.evaluation_en: Linux kernel implementation; three live Starlink terminals in Madrid, New Jersey and Cebu; four Oracle servers; over fifty two-minute tests per CCA. LeoReplayer records 4,800 two-minute traces with saturated UDP plus ICMP probes and replays identical conditions for controlled comparisons.
papers.evaluation_zh: Linux kernel implementation；Madrid、New Jersey、Cebu 三個 live Starlink terminals，四個 Oracle servers；每個 CCA 超過五十次、每次至少兩分鐘測試。LeoReplayer 以 saturated UDP 加 ICMP probes 收集 4,800 筆兩分鐘 traces，並 replay 相同 conditions 作 controlled comparisons。
papers.baselines_en: TCP Reno, CUBIC, Vegas, BBRv1, BBRv3, VIVACE, Proteus, Copa, Verus, Sage and SaTCP. SaTCP receives LeoCC’s reconfiguration detector as its handover signal; LeoCC-SS and other component ablations isolate the design.
papers.baselines_zh: TCP Reno、CUBIC、Vegas、BBRv1、BBRv3、VIVACE、Proteus、Copa、Verus、Sage、SaTCP。SaTCP 使用 LeoCC reconfiguration detector 作 handover signal；LeoCC-SS 與其他 component ablations 隔離設計效益。
papers.result_en: Reported throughput rises 85–494% versus CUBIC/Copa/BBRv3 and delay falls 44–56% versus BBRv1/VIVACE. Controlled average utilization is 95.2% for LeoCC and 95.8% for BBRv1; the main gain couples high utilization with lower delay.
papers.result_zh: 報告 throughput 對 CUBIC/Copa/BBRv3 增加 85–494%；delay 對 BBRv1/VIVACE 降低 44–56%。controlled average utilization 為 LeoCC 95.2%、BBRv1 95.8%；主要效益是高 utilization 搭配低 delay。
papers.limitations_en: LeoReplayer relies on the measured Starlink ICMP/data queue separation and access-link behavior. Optical cluster fabrics need their own reconfiguration, queue and failure calibration. Fairness with BBRv1 reaches Jain 0.98–0.99 in the tested configuration.
papers.limitations_zh: LeoReplayer 依賴量測 Starlink 的 ICMP/data queue separation 與 access-link behavior。optical cluster fabrics 需要其自身 reconfiguration、queue、failure calibration。測試 configuration 中與 BBRv1 的 fairness 達 Jain 0.98–0.99。
